title: Currency-safe grouping and totals in dynamic sales-order report
description: User scene: in the visual sales-order report, choose customer or month grouping and see count and amount totals for the currently authorized preview page. Keep each currency separate and label page totals explicitly; preserve ERP-112 permission and salesperson scope. Invalid group keys fail closed. Read-only requests retain the existing request audit; no model SQL, database writes, migration, real database execution, secret/.env change, or deployment. Verify with unit tests and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: The API accepts only none/customer/month group keys and computes deterministic count and amount totals from the same bounded authorized preview rows; never combines currencies.
The designer offers allowed grouping choices and labels each result as a page subtotal by currency, including empty groups and pagination changes.
Tests cover mixed currencies, month boundary, scope-limited rows, empty page, invalid group key and no writes; document page-subtotal semantics.
